news.headline: ADAR1 Capital and Daniel Schneeberger buy roughly 770,000 TENX shares in the open market
news.summary: Private investment funds managed by ADAR1 Capital Management, together with Daniel Schneeberger, reported open-market purchases totaling 770,333 shares between August 31 and September 2 at a weighted average price around $1.79, adding to the roughly 1.0 million shares the group bought in late August. The buying by a top-ten-percent holder is the clearest bullish signal since the LEVEL trial miss.

news.headline: Guggenheim downgrades Tenax Therapeutics to Neutral from Buy after the ESC data presentation
news.summary: Guggenheim moved off its Buy rating to Neutral with no price target, citing substantial clinical and regulatory uncertainty after reviewing the full LEVEL dataset presented at ESC. It had already cut its price target to $4 from $40 immediately after the August 10 primary-endpoint miss while still rating the stock Buy, so the move to Neutral marks a further step down.

news.headline: Full Phase 3 LEVEL data presented as a late-breaker at ESC Congress 2026 in Munich
news.summary: Professor Sanjiv Shah presented the complete LEVEL dataset: in the prespecified subgroup with baseline 6-minute walk distance below the trial median of 333m, levosimendan improved 6MWD by 26.3m versus placebo (p=0.0112), cut NT-proBNP by 47% (p<0.0001) and lowered right ventricular systolic pressure by 4.9 mmHg (p=0.009), with roughly 20 echocardiographic parameters improved across every domain measured. The depth of the subgroup and biomarker data is the basis for Tenax's plan to pursue a narrower registrational path with the FDA.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics (NASDAQ:TENX) Rating Lowered to Strong Sell at Wall Street Zen
news.summary: Wall Street Zen cut its rating on Tenax from Sell to Strong Sell days after the failed Phase 3 LEVEL readout. The downgrade reflects post-trial-failure caution even as some sell-side peers stayed constructive.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics (TENX) holder BVF reports 3.11M shares, big warrant overhang
news.summary: A regulatory filing shows BVF Partners holding roughly 3.11 million TENX shares, with the disclosure highlighting a substantial outstanding warrant overhang. Large institutional positioning and potential future dilution remain a key overhang after the trial miss.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Announces Topline Results from Phase 3 LEVEL Clinical Trial of TNX-103 in Patients with PH-HFpEF
news.summary: The pivotal LEVEL trial missed its primary endpoint (6-minute walk distance, +3.5m vs placebo, p=0.63) and its key secondary endpoint (KCCQ), though prespecified subgroups of sicker patients showed a 26.3-meter benefit, a 49% NT-proBNP reduction, and a 3.5 mmHg RVSP improvement. Shares collapsed roughly 87-90% on the news, and Tenax said it will seek an FDA Type C meeting to discuss a revised registrational path.

catalysts.label: CEO presentation at 2026 Cantor Global Healthcare Conference
catalysts.detail: President and CEO Chris Giordano presents at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference on Wednesday, September 9, 2026 at 8:35 a.m. ET, with a live and archived webcast available on the investor relations site. It is the first scheduled public forum for management to field questions since the full LEVEL data went up at ESC on August 29, including on the FDA Type C meeting strategy and the ADAR1/Schneeberger insider buying.

catalysts.label: FDA Type C meeting on levosimendan path forward
catalysts.detail: Following the LEVEL primary-endpoint miss, Tenax plans to request a Type C meeting with the FDA (and consult the EMA) to discuss revising the registrational program, potentially narrowing eligibility toward more severely affected PH-HFpEF patients using the subgroup and biomarker data presented at ESC. Outcome will determine whether LEVEL-2 is modified or a new study is required; no meeting date has been announced yet.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings / cash runway and strategy update
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly report should update the cash position (runway guided to Q2 2028 as of Q2 2026) and provide concrete next steps for the levosimendan program following the LEVEL trial failure, including any outcome from the planned FDA Type C meeting.

catalysts.label: LEVEL-2 Phase 3 enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: The global, ~540-patient LEVEL-2 registrational trial (2:1 randomization) remains ongoing, with enrollment completion previously guided to end of 2027. Design and enrollment criteria may still be revised pending FDA feedback from the planned Type C meeting.

pulse: TENX trades around $2.20, still down roughly 87-90% from pre-LEVEL-miss levels after the Phase 3 trial failed its primary endpoint on August 10, but the tone has firmed slightly since. The August 29 ESC Congress late-breaker gave the fullest look yet at the salvageable subgroup - patients below the 333m baseline 6-minute-walk median showed a 26.3m benefit (p=0.0112), a 47% NT-proBNP reduction and roughly 20 improved echocardiographic parameters - yet Guggenheim still cut its rating to Neutral from Buy on August 31 citing clinical and regulatory uncertainty, even as Piper Sandler holds a Buy with a $14 target. The clearest bullish signal is insider buying: ADAR1 Capital/Daniel Schneeberger funds bought roughly 770,000 shares between August 31 and September 2 near $1.79, on top of about 1 million shares bought in late August. With $118M of cash guided into Q2 2028, the next scheduled events are CEO Chris Giordano's September 9 presentation at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference and the still-unrequested FDA Type C meeting that will decide whether a narrower LEVEL-2 registrational path is viable.
